notes.addresses: TRON addresses may be written as Base58Check (T...) or as the 20-byte 0x form; the tool converts and checks the checksum. Signers and guardians are the same secp256k1 keys as on the Ethereum vault, so their 0x addresses are the same 20 bytes (TRON derives an address from a key exactly as Ethereum does and prefixes 0x41)
notes.limits: the Ethereum bridge's launch values, proposed for this network: cap 100,000 USDT (must equal the L2 supplyCap), window 10,000 per 24 h (also the largest deposit and the largest burn), minDeposit 66, l2MinBurn 65 (derived from the fixed release fee: the fee is at most 20% of the smallest exit), 6 of 7 to end a pause or switch, 14 days switch delay, 72 h pause and cooldown
notes.fees: 5 bps of each deposit, and 5 bps plus a fixed 13 USDT of each release (releaseFlat 13000000; the bps ceiling is 30 in the contract). The fixed fee is NOT an estimate: it is the worst-case cost of one release to its relayer (no staked energy, a recipient that never held USDT) at the chain's current unit prices and USDT's dynamic-energy factor, times 1.5, rounded up to a whole USDT. The measured numbers, the chain values, the TRX price and the formula are in vault.provenance.fees.basis; `tron_deploy.py validate` recomputes it and refuses a fee below it or above 20% of l2MinBurn, and `create` recomputes it again from the node and the day's TRX price. Decided by the coordinator (technical) on 2026-11-17; the 5 + 5 bps stay. All fees are accrued outside the backing; anyone calls sweepFees() and the vault pays the recipient. recipient TCQ2d5gxTczSeN2oeni16JwMW7HWLzXEKc = 0x1aa1fc9a1b311556132b30af41026ca5c6b6fafc, the owner's TRON address given on 2026-11-16 (Base58Check checksum verified). It is a constructor argument: immutable once deployed. Relayers stake or rent energy, so their real cost is far below the fee
notes.deploy: consumeUserResourcePercent 100 and originEnergyLimit 1: callers pay all energy, the deployer account never subsidises a call. TRON lets the creator account change these two settings and clear the stored ABI later; none of them touches funds or logic (docs/TRON-VAULT-DIFF.md section 2). feeLimitSun 1,500 TRX covers the creation (4.42 M energy measured = about 442 TRX at 100 sun) with margin; the chain maximum is 15,000 TRX
